intro: Wind down without clutter. Zyne keeps your book, phone, and glasses close, while the calm Sonoma Oak finish and hidden hardware help your room feel quieter, tidier, and easier to breathe in.

features.title: Essentials within easy reach
features.text: Keep your night routine simple. The top and handy storage space hold your book, phone, and glasses, so you settle in faster and wake to a clear, calm bedside that starts your day on the right note.

features.title: Fits small spaces beautifully
features.text: A compact, streamlined silhouette slides in neatly beside your bed, keeping walkways free and your layout balanced, so the table serves you without crowding the room or stealing visual space.

features.title: Built for everyday durability
features.text: Crafted from 15 mm prelaminated particle board, it stands up to daily use while staying easy to wipe clean, helping your bedside look cared for with little effort from you.

features.title: Finish that warms and blends
features.text: The Sonoma Oak brown finish brings gentle warmth that pairs with light or dark linens, letting you switch bedding styles through seasons while the bedside remains a steady, grounding accent.

name: Zyne Engineered Wood Bedside Table
